WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') as fundflux,
    COUNT(sq.qualregistry) as count
  FROM scanqc sq
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing')
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_sources
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
  gd.fundflux,
  gd.count,
  gd.count::float / t.total_count as fraction,
  gd.count::float / (t.total_count::float / t.num_sources) as ratio_to_avg
FROM grouped_data gd
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY gd.fundflux
